1) Press the HOME button on the remote. If the TV asks which home screen to use, choose this launcher and press Always.\n2) If nothing is asked, ask a family member to run this on a computer connected to the TV:\nadb shell cmd package set-home-activity vn.simpletv.launcher/.HomeActivity
